lines.text: The root is Rupt! Disrupt, eruption.
Did you know? Rupt is Latin for break.
Quick quiz! Which means out plus break?

words.ex: The strike disrupted rail services across the country.

publish.title: Rupt root: disrupt and eruption
publish.value: Rupt comes from Latin "rumpere" (to break). Words: disrupt and eruption. disrupt = dis + rupt; eruption = e + rupt.
